title: Soft launch: hint at someone (or something) new without showing it
summary: Three to five soft, dreamy clips that hint at a person, pet or product without showing it, one line of text, and a reveal on the chorus.
why: New Engen's Instagram trends page, updated November 13, 2026, calls this soft-launch format the top TikTok trend that week and says it has spread to Instagram. People post 3 to 5 soft-focus clips that only hint at someone new (hands, the back of a head, a shared view), set to a gentle acoustic love-song cover, with the reveal on the chorus. It suggests brands swap the partner for a new product, a shop dog or a new location.
steps: Decide what you're soft launching: a partner, a new pet, a new home, a new product or a new spot.
Paste the main prompt into a chatbot to get a shot list and your one line of text.
Film 3 to 5 short clips, 7 to 12 seconds in total, keeping faces or the full product out of frame until the last clip.
Pick the soft acoustic love-song cover trending under soft-launch posts in your app, and line the reveal up with the chorus.

prompts.label: Main prompt: shot list and caption
prompts.text: I want to make a 'soft launch' Reel that hints at [what's new, for example: my new partner / our new puppy / my first apartment] without fully showing it. Give me 4 short shot ideas, each 2 to 3 seconds, that only show small details: hands, a shadow, the back of a head, a shared view, a little daily ritual. Make the last shot a gentle reveal. Then write 5 options for one line of on-screen text, under 8 words each, sweet and a little mysterious. Plain, warm language. No hashtags.

prompts.label: Variation: new pet
prompts.text: Help me soft launch our new pet in a 10-second Reel. Give me 4 shot ideas that only hint at it: a tiny bowl, a leash by the door, a paw on a blanket, a tail out of frame. The last shot shows its face. Then write 5 short on-screen lines, under 8 words, cute but not cheesy.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: We're about to launch [new product, menu item or location] at our [type of business]. Plan a 10-second soft-launch Reel that only hints at it: 4 close-up shot ideas (packaging edges, hands at work, a shadow on the counter, a peek through a door), with the last shot a clear but simple reveal. Write 5 one-line on-screen captions under 8 words that build curiosity without fake urgency or 'limited time' claims. Add one short post caption with the real launch date: [date].

tips: Soft focus does the work: tap to focus on something near the lens so the rest blurs.
Keep it to one line of text. The hints should carry the story.
Check the sound is cleared for business accounts, or use original audio.
Soft launching a person? Make sure they're happy to be posted first.
